_note: The guided first day. mochi's lines (the donut guide), by step id. The steps themselves (what to point at and when each is done) are in TutorialScene; they follow the game's state, so a burnt donut sends you back to 'drop'. {station} is replaced with a station name.
intro: hi! I'm mochi, domochi's donut buddy. Ethan, who started domochi (Lafayette's first mochi donut shop!), asked me to show you around.
mochi donuts are made with rice flour and shaped into a ring of little pull-apart bubbles, like me! light and crispy outside, soft and chewy inside.
let's make your first order together. I'll point at each thing to tap.

steps.customer: here comes a customer! tap them to take their order.
steps.take: tap Take order. their ticket goes up on the rail at the top.
steps.goTo: head to the {station} station (down at the bottom).
steps.scoop: first we need dough! tap each ingredient to scoop it into the bowl. I'll point at the next one (the recipe's underneath).
steps.stir: now stir: drag round and round in the bowl until it’s smooth.
steps.tub: smooth! tap Into the tub. one batch makes 8 donuts; scoop double for 16.
steps.drop: tap Drop to put a donut in the oil.
steps.flip: watch its meter: the bottom bar goes red, orange, then green. at green it hops: tap it to flip!
steps.pull: now the top. when that bar is green too and it starts steaming, drag it onto the rack.
steps.tray: tap the fried donut (or drag it) onto the tray.
steps.cup: cookies & cream gets our white cookies & cream glaze. tap that cup.
steps.pour: press on the donut and pour, following the dashed loops all the way round.
steps.glazeDone: beautiful. tap Done to put it on the shelf.
steps.shelf: tap the glazed donut to bring it to the toppings tray.
steps.jar: it needs crushed chocolate cookies. tap that jar.
steps.shake: press and drag round the ring to shake the crumbs on, nice and even.
steps.pack: tap the donut to put it in the box. the slots are numbered in the ticket's order.
steps.serve: close the lid! it goes straight to the customer.
steps.card: every station gets a score, and a great order earns a great tip. tap to head back.

outro: you did it! that's the whole kitchen: fry, glaze, toppings, box.
you can make donuts ahead of time, and keep a few orders going at once. let's open for the day!
